item.title: We have entered a new era of obesity medicine. The short-term results of GLP-1 a…
item.description: We have entered a new era of obesity medicine. The short-term results of GLP-1 agonists (like Ozempic/Wegovy) are undeniable. But we are ignoring a massive, looming question: What happens when you stop? The data is clear: Without an exit strategy, we are setting patients up for a “rebound” that leaves them metabolically and functionally worse off than when they started.
